paper_frame.accepted_position: Fixed relationship-memory incumbent-relative candidate-conditioned event ranking evidence valuation and constrained decision-quality under specific protocols
rejected_positions: production net speedup or unconditional deployment improvement
paper_frame.central_question: When does an independently fixed relationship-memory ranker improve the incumbent's NDCG@10 on the available candidates, and can pre-outcome prediction of its marginal value support specialist selection under a stipulated call constraint?
paper_frame.thesis: The marginal ranking utility of a fixed relationship-memory specialist depends on the incumbent and candidate context; estimating it can improve specialist choice relative to the specified baseline objectives under a declared call constraint.
paper_frame.primary_novelty_unit: Empirical conjunction of fixed-expert relative utility, conditional evidence states, candidate-indexed rank labels, and frozen policy evaluation; not standalone new gate mathematics.

n2_open_decisions.question: Does measured specialist invocation have an actual scarce/costly resource basis?
Is new independent fair two-stage-L2D / DS-Frame-style comparator required for publishable scientific novelty?
Is a newly independent exactly matched invocation/cost protocol feasible?
Would new candidate/task replication materially elevate C2 beyond retrospective diagnosis?
What data/model source materials can legally be published and durably archived?
